id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

title.description: The title of the inline notification.

subtitle.description: The subtitle of the inline notification.

status.description: The status of the inline notification. If omitted, it is displayed with a white background and no icon.

icon.description: Whether or not to show an icon relating to the status.

firstButtonConfig.description: The configuration for the first button to be displayed related to the notification

secondButtonConfig.description: The configuration for the second button to be displayed related to the notification

hidden.description: Whether or not the inline notification would be hidden.

closable.description: Whether or not the user can close the notification through the UI. When set to true, a close button will be displayed.

title:
Custom {@link UiSdlInlineNotification} component that supports line breaks in the given title and subtitle,
and automatically selects an icon based on the provided status.
name: ReliabilityInlineNotification
